description: HISTORICAL SCHEMA-DRIFT REGRESSION (FORNX-55): the adapter originally assumed shell exec always arrives as event_msg{type:exec_command_end}. A real codex-cli 0.147.0 exec turn never emits that shape at all — shell exec is instead wrapped as a response_item pair, custom_tool_call (invocation, command embedded in a JS snippet string) followed by custom_tool_call_output (free-text result, no exit code), matched by call_id. This fixture pins that real pair down so a future adapter change cannot silently regress to assuming only the exec_command_end shape exists.

payload.name: exec
payload.input: const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"echo hi",workdir:"/workspace"}); text(r.output);
